adjudication_records.issue_text: app/assets/stylesheets/common/base/topic-post.scss:15 — Missing abstraction: the same verbose `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, X), scale-color($secondary, 100-X))` pair is hand-written ~109 times; a single helper function/mixin would enforce the mirror and prevent the copy-paste value drift seen above.

adjudication.rationale: The diff introduces many repeated, verbose patterns like `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: N%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: M%))` across numerous SCSS files/lines. The intended pairing often appears to be a mirrored relationship (e.g., primary 30% with secondary 70%), but the diff shows inconsistent pairs in some places (e.g., `desktop/topic-post.scss` changes a selector to `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%)` with secondary 30% where surrounding similar rules use primary 30/secondary 70; `mobile/modal.scss` also uses primary 30/secondary 70 where it previously used primary 70). A helper/mixin would reduce copy-paste and prevent this kind of value drift. This is a maintainability/consistency concern rather than a directly verifiable functional defect.
